sentences.text:
Dabur India Limited vs Union Of India & Ors on 17 September,
2025
 17-09-2025
Item Nos.46 & 47

In The High Court At Calcutta
 Subrata Constitutional Writ Jurisdiction
Bhattacharyya Appellate Side
 Ar(C)
 Wpa No.26167 of 2024
 Dabur India Limited
 -vs-
 Union of India & Ors.
 with
 Wpa No.8975 of 2025
 Mr. Sudipto Sarkar, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Sourajit Dasgupta
 Mr. Sudhakar Prasad
 Mr. Nilanjan Banerjee ...for the petitioner
 Ms. Vineeta Meharia, sr. adv.
 Mr. Amit Meharia
 Ms. Pannistha Singh
 Ms. Paramita Banerjee
 Mr. Rohan Raj
 ...for the respondent nos.2-4
1.

It has been submitted by the learned senior counsel for the petitioner that as shelf life of the
subject batch of the product in respect of which prohibitory order and thereafter recall order was
passed by the Fssai has expired, accordingly, the writ petitions have become infructuous.

2. Learned counsel for Fssai relies upon the order dated January 29, 2025 passed by the Joint
Director (Regulatory Compliance) in support of the submission that the prosecution case has
already been initiated and the same is pending consideration.
3.  As the shelf life of the subject product has already expired, accordingly, no order needs to be passed in the instant writ petitions.
The Court has not entered into the merits of the matters.
All points raised in the writ petitions are left open to be agitated as and when fresh cause of action arises.
4. Since the writ petitions are being disposed of without calling for affidavits, the allegations contained therein shall be deemed not to have been admitted by the respondents.
5. The writ petitions are disposed of.
